verdict.rationale: The only on-topic support is one old community report from the 2021 beta saying cost scales to zero and the same instance scales up under massive load (comm-9). Current first-party material points to operator-driven scaling instead: manually adjusting VTTablet sizes per shard (docs-36), adding read replicas (docs-22) and sharding (docs-15). Missing for 10: first-party documentation of automatic compute autoscaling up and down, evidence that resizes happen without downtime, and current independent corroboration.
